comparison_mode: observer-only fixed warm in-memory XLS capture

equivalence_exclusions.reason: Fresh-child timing, process snapshots, and allocator vectors are summarized per repetition; they are not semantic or logical-I/O equivalence fields.

limitations: Elapsed p50/p95/p99 and allocator vectors are per-child descriptive observations.
This observer-only comparison makes no production speedup or regression claim.
The warm generated corpus does not establish cold-file, physical-I/O, remote-source, scaling, or cache behavior.
The source scope marker difference is explicitly permitted only at result.source.xls.source_counter_scope; logical ReadAt vectors, locality flags, output digests, and corpus identity remain equal.

protocol.acceptance: All logical I/O counters and output hashes equivalent; observer scope marker must differ explicitly. Source observer result measures instrumentation change only. Review >5% eager latency/RSS regressions. Plain source results single-revision baseline only.

counters.scope: Whole process, scaled multiplexed events; not operation IPC or cache miss rate

protocol.isolation: Fresh sequential child per repetition; warmup and retained samples share process. No concurrent build/test/benchmark.
limitations: No cold-cache or physical I/O claim
No scaling or exact L1/LLC claim
protocol.memory: Allocation calls include reallocations; peak/live values are process snapshots; RSS is whole-process.
protocol.purpose: Isolate XLS diagnostic observer overhead and establish plain OwnedSource production lifecycle baselines. No production speedup claim.
protocol.timer: Existing open/query brackets, input clone and source construction outside; output semantic oracle and locality validation outside.
